summary: Master negotiation techniques tailored for support officers. Join our training course to boost your skills and confidently handle challenging conversations.
lede: Negotiation skills for support officers help service desk agents and other front-line support professionals resolve complex requests while balancing stakeholder needs with operational constraints. Learners practise de-escalating tense conversations, identifying stakeholder interests, adapting communication across tickets, chat and phone, coordinating internal resources, and documenting resolution plans within SLA boundaries.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals operating on the front lines of service delivery and escalation management.
modules: Foundations of Support Negotiation and Conflict Dynamics
Delivering Bad News and Managing Concessions
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience within a customer support, IT helpdesk, or service delivery environment. Familiarity with standard CRM or ticketing systems (such as Zendesk, Jira Service Management, or Salesforce Service Cloud) is recommended. No prior formal negotiation training is required.
